newsitem.title: UK: New insurer to offer shipowners OPA90 certificates.
newsitem.headline: New insurer to offer shipowners OPA90 certificates.

text.p: Bermuda-based reinsurance company Stockton Re has formed an insurance vehicle to provide shipowners with financial responsibility certificates required by the U.S. Coastguard.
The Shipowners Insurance and Guaranty Company (SIGCo) is based in Bermuda with paid up capital of U.S. $25 million, a statement said.

It will provide Certificates of Financial Responsibility, the so-called tickets-to-trade required by the U.S. authorities under the Oil Pollution Act (OPA90) of up to U.S. $400 million for shipowners belonging to recognised protection and indemnity clubs.

The company will be run by trustees on behalf of the shipowners, but redeemable preference share capital has been provided by Stockton Re, Ace Ltd, and Global Capital Re. These will be phased out over time.
Stockton Re said a comprehensive reinsurance programme is in place to protect SIGCo against exposures of U.S. $399 million per vessel per incident.
The scheme takes effect from 28 December 1996 -- Reuters Insurance News +44 171 542 2770
